Question.title: Question
Question.description: Survei minat dan bakat question entity with 6 categorical options.

options.description: Array of 6 categorical options (sains, teknologi, seni, olahraga, bahasa, bisnis).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the question was created.

SurveyResponse.title: SurveyResponse
SurveyResponse.description: Student survey result including category scores, dominant talent, and profile details.

studentClass.description: Class or grade level of the student.

dominantCategory.description: Primary talent category key (sains, teknologi, seni, olahraga, bahasa, bisnis).

categoryScores.description: Score distribution map per talent category.

answers.description: Map of questionId to chosen category.

/questions/{questionId}.description: Collection of survey questions managed by school administrators.
